mapper.sql: session_id, user_id, client_type, client_instance, ip_address, user_agent, login_at, last_seen_at, expires_at, revoked_at, logout_at, revoke_reason
mapper.select: SELECT FROM iam_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY login_at DESC, session_id
SELECT FROM iam_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY login_at DESC, session_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_session (session_id, user_id, client_type, client_instance, ip_address, user_agent, login_at, last_seen_at, expires_at, revoked_at, logout_at, revoke_reason) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{clientType}, #{clientInstance}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{loginAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{logoutAt}, #{revokeReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_session SET client_type = #{clientType}, client_instance = #{clientInstance}, ip_address = #{ipAddress}, user_agent = #{userAgent}, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, logout_at = #{logoutAt}, revoke_reason = #{revokeReason} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
